ORDINANCE May 22.20 ZY

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. |-Min the area bounded by:

A tine 329 feet South of and parallel to West Washington Boulevard; North Menard Avenue;
Aline 379 feet South of and parallel to West Washington Boulevard; and the public alley
next west of and parallel to North Menard Avenue

To those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shalt be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 30 N. Menard Chicago, IL 60644
